evals.prompt: Deslop the current branch before I send it for review. It's stacked on origin/feature/full-history; the next PR in the stack builds on it.
evals.expected_output: Trivial comment/indirection slop fixed in the 11 files of the bench-query/01 commit; forward-declared code, stringly-typed rows, Duration-as-unit, guard cascades and speculative extension points reported with file:line; build and tests pass; no behavior change.
expectations: Edits touch only files changed between origin/feature/full-history and HEAD (the 11 files under cmd/stellar-rpc/internal/rpcv2/bench)
go build and go test of ./cmd/stellar-rpc/internal/rpcv2/bench pass after the edits
The //nolint:unused and //nolint:unparam items that cite bench-query/02-read-path are reported, and the code they mark is not deleted
The redundant overflow guards in runPacedLeg (warmup > math.MaxInt-measured, or intervalNS >= MaxInt64) are reported or removed with a stated proof
queryStageRow / queryDriverRow as renamed rateRow are removed or reported
Suffix-based row classification (keepsZeroSamples, driverLegCountSuffix, count[1:] in logRow) is reported as stringly-typed
Rates, counts or bytes carried in time.Duration fields are reported
runEnv.Extra with no production writer, or the one-member scratchPrefix const block, is reported as speculative
The maxLegRequests byte-arithmetic comment is shortened or reported
No error string, CSV row label, flag name or JSON field name is changed by the patch
The report opens with a 1-3 sentence summary and lists items left for the author with file:line
